title: Turkish
description: Everyday Turkish: greetings, family, food, numbers, getting around and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
tips: 'Merhaba' works any time. When parting, the person leaving says 'hoşça kal' and the person staying says 'güle güle'.

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
tips: 'My' is a suffix: 'anne' (mother) becomes 'annem' (my mother), 'baba' becomes 'babam'.

units.title: Food and drink
tips: Turkish puts the verb at the end: 'Kahve içiyorum' = (I) coffee am drinking.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
tips: Nouns stay singular after a number: 'iki çay' (two teas), 'dört elma' (four apples).

units.title: Travel and directions
units.description: Find your way around a new city.
tips: Endings show direction and place: 'sola' (to the left), 'sağda' (on the right), 'evde' (at home).

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.
tips: Dotted 'i' and dotless 'ı' are different letters: 'kız' (girl, daughter) needs the dotless ı.
